title: The Lake Before the Storm
description: Read the weather from cover, then board the ferry and transfer across the open lake.

signs.text: Board the ferry when it reaches the jetty
Wait for the warning to clear before crossing
The ferry climbs towards the high jetty
Cross the headland above the lake
Use the landing shelters between storm lanes
The last boat carries you back to shore
